formats.childBehavior: One decompressed child for the concatenation; use the filename without .gz or the first-member FNAME, otherwise content. Feed child bytes to ordinary format sniffing without an octet-stream MIME hint.
formats.budget: Budget actual output chunks before retaining; ratio checked per physical member; count each member; return listed without inflating for children=list. Preflight child depth only for children=extract.

formats.detect: ustar magic at byte offset 257; legacy V7 TAR has no confident signature and remains unsupported by this detector
formats.childBehavior: Regular entries enter normal child extraction in header order. Directories and special entries are skipped; symlinks and hardlinks are listed only and never followed. Normalize names to relative plain paths.
formats.budget: Tick every archive/data loop; add entry budget per header; charge exposed file and extension-header bytes; check tar boundaries before child creation. For children=list, parse bounded PAX/GNU metadata but do not inspect regular payloads. Preflight depth only for children=extract regular files.

integrationAfterPublicExtractExists: Register gzip and tar in the format registry/lazy readers; do not alter public options, model, limits, manifests, or dependency lockfiles.
Ensure gzip output can be sniffed as TAR; .tar.gz is the gzip child followed by the tar reader through ordinary nested extractChild routing.
Validate generated reader functions against the real child pipeline and shared Budget, including children=list, children=skip, and child-depth refusal.
limits: These readers are not registered in the public extraction pipeline yet.
Corpus fixtures are synthetic CC0 fixtures; they are focused fixtures, not public golden outputs.
Fuzz entry points are added, but this branch does not modify the repository fuzz runner/registration manifest.
